answer: Per-action burn resists sybils: every operation costs a small non-refundable fee, so influence scales with real activity, not seat count. A lone honest agent spends little; a swarm acting at scale burns a nebula of fees that thins its budget like a starved vine. Dormant fakes are harmless and active ones costly, so splitting into a string of onyx-dark identities buys no edge — cost follows the work, never the head count.
